title: Naturality of the eight-factor source comparison
statement: Fix a finite purity datum P [def-pur-conventions], schemes X,Y,Z with Y over k, morphisms f:X->Y and g:Y->Z, and d,e in N. Let I_K:L(gf)*K(d+e)[2(d+e)] -> Lf*(Lg*K(e)[2e])(d)[2d] be the actual eight-factor comparison of [def-pur-composition-comparisons], with intrinsic realization on both sides, as expressed by [def-pur-composition-model-orientation-coordinates]. For arbitrary derived coefficient objects K,L on Z and a:K->L, shifted composite pullback of a followed by I_L equals I_K followed by iterated shifted pullback of a. No constructibility hypothesis on a or its endpoints is needed.

proof.text: Use naturality of the eight specified factors in their recorded order. Their ordered product is fixed by CompositionSourceNormalized, and uniqueness identifies this product with compositionSourceFixed. Applying intrinsic realization preserves the resulting naturality square.
